notes.title: New demo available for Hank's Voyage!
notes.notes:
The latest demo for Hank's Voyage is now available on Steam for Windows, Mac OS, and Linux! 

The demo features the first 4 levels of the game and a bunch of unlockables for those who like to explore more. The current content is a good introduction to the game's core mechanics, story, and overall atmosphere.

You can download it by visiting the Store page of the game.

Enjoy!
